learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and capacity to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of materials technology.

syllabus_topics: Metallurgical and microstructural aspects of materials processing
Materials degradation mechanisms and defect detection techniques
Analysis of in-service behavior and material selection in industrial applications
teaching_methods: Self-study through basic and complementary bibliography and supplementary material
Use of Granta Edupack Introductory interactive application
assessment_rules: The final grade is the sum of the scores obtained in the Continuous Assessment Test (for students who submit it, as it is voluntary) and the face-to-face exam. A student who takes the face-to-face exam but has not submitted the Continuous Assessment Test on time can obtain a maximum final grade of 9 points. To pass the course, a minimum final grade of five points must be obtained. The Continuous Assessment Test grade is saved for the September resit, but its submission can only be done for the February call.
